units.source_text: “医生说治好是不可能了，不过眼下还不用担心。”

en.t: The doctor says a cure is impossible, but there is no need to worry for now.

units.source_text: “要是这样还可以，既然医生这么说，问题就不大。

en.t: If that is the case, then it should be all right; since the doctor says so, it is not a serious problem.

units.source_text: 我刚才说的那个人是不注意身体的人，而且是个非常粗鲁的军人。”

en.t: The person I was just talking about was someone who paid no attention to his health, and on top of that he was a very rough soldier.

units.source_text: 我心里踏实了一些。

en.t: I felt somewhat relieved.

units.source_text: 先生一直观察着我的表情，然后又补了一句：

en.t: Sensei had been watching my expression the whole time, and then he added:

units.source_text: “不过，健康也好，生病也罢，不管怎么说，人都是脆弱的。

en.t: Still, whether healthy or ill, people are fragile in any case.

units.source_text: 说不定什么时候，什么缘故就死了。”

en.t: One never knows when, or for what reason, one may die.

units.source_text: “先生也在想这种事吗？”

en.t: Do you think about such things too, Sensei?

units.source_text: “无论我身体怎么好，也不会完全不想的。”

en.t: No matter how healthy I may be, it is not as if I never think about them at all.

units.source_text: 先生的嘴边浮出一丝微笑。

en.t: A faint smile appeared at the corners of Sensei's mouth.

units.source_text: “不是经常有人突然间就死了吗？

en.t: People often die all of a sudden, do they not?

units.source_text: 像正常死亡之类的。

en.t: By natural death, for example.

units.source_text: 也有人一眨眼的工夫就没了，因为非自然的暴力。”

en.t: And some people are gone in the blink of an eye because of unnatural violence.

units.source_text: “非自然的暴力，是什么？”

en.t: What is unnatural violence?

units.source_text: “是什么我也不知道，但自杀的人使用的都是非自然的暴力吧。”

en.t: I do not know what it is either, but people who commit suicide all use unnatural violence, I suppose.

units.source_text: “那么被杀死的，也是因为非自然的暴力了？”

en.t: Then being killed is also because of unnatural violence?

units.source_text: “被杀死的算不算，我没有想过。

en.t: I have not thought about whether being killed counts.

units.source_text: 也可以这样说吧。”

en.t: I suppose you could put it that way.

units.source_text: 那天说到这里，我就回住处了。

en.t: That day, after the conversation reached this point, I went back to my lodging.

units.source_text: 回到住处以后，对父亲的病也不觉得那么难过了。

en.t: After I returned to my lodging, I no longer felt so distressed about my father's illness.

units.source_text: 先生说的正常死亡、非暴力死亡等等，也只给我留下了一些很浅的印象，很快便忘得干干净净了。

en.t: Sensei's words about natural death, death without violence, and the like left only a very shallow impression on me, and I soon forgot them completely.

units.source_text: 我想起了以前几次要动手写，但一直没有着手的毕业论文，觉得应该正式开始写了。

en.t: I remembered the graduation thesis I had several times meant to start writing but had never actually begun, and I felt that I ought to start it in earnest.
